name: Altay main battle tank
armament: 12.7 mm in Aselsan SARP remote weapon station
protection: Modular composite armour; Altay T2 adds AKKOR active protection and more armour. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetration needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon, best against side, rear and engine deck.
visual_notes: Long hull with 7 road wheels per side and flat side skirts
Angular welded turret with large rear bustle, Korean K2-influenced layout
Remote weapon station and commander sight on the roof
First deliveries late 2025, so rare on the map
